config_name: LG gram 17 (AI) — Core Ultra 9 288V, Arc 140V iGPU, 32GB, 1TB, 17" touch; bundled 1TB docking station

battery.notes: Lunar Lake is the most efficient gram silicon; estimated 12-14h real-world light use — best in line.

price.notes: Reg $3,799 / sale $3,039 incl. bundled 1TB docking station (BBY-verified 2026-11-24). SKU 19838158.

offers.name: LG gram 17" Touchscreen Laptop - Intel Core Ultra 9 288V - 32GB DDR5 - 1TB SSD - Intel Arc Graphics - Windows 11 - Obsidian Black - 1TB Docking Station

reviews.quote: Better than ever, yet business as usual: remarkable battery runtimes (~22h realistic) and a big 17-inch screen at barely 1.3 kg, though the case is slightly bendy.

praises: Lunar Lake efficiency gives the best real battery life of any gram — users report full workdays with margin
17-inch touch display at ~1.35 kg still shocks people who lift it expecting a desktop replacement
32GB RAM standard suits heavy browser/Office multitasking
Bundled 1TB docking station offsets the missing ports complaint at this price
Arc 140V handles light video editing and casual gaming far better than older Intel iGPUs
complaints: Ultra 9 288V is an efficiency part — sustained multi-core renders lag Arrow Lake H chips
60 Hz glossy panel at a $3.8k list price feels stingy
RAM is on-package and cannot be upgraded at all
Lid flex on the 17" chassis; hinge wobble while typing
LG's Canadian service/parts network is thin compared to Dell/Lenovo

design_philosophy: This is the gram thesis taken to its efficiency extreme: Lunar Lake's on-package memory and low-power Arc 140V graphics let a 17-inch Copilot+ laptop run cool, silent, and ~13 real-world hours on a charge at ~1.35 kg. The 32GB tier plus a bundled dock rounds out what the thin chassis lacks. It suits mobile professionals who value battery and weight over sustained compute.
